title: About
description: Learn about this archive, its history, its purpose and the people behind it.
searchText: About this archive, its background, history, owner and collection.

archive.name: My Archive
archive.subtitle: A place for preserving knowledge, history and information.
archive.description: Welcome to My Archive. This project brings together documents, articles, research, photographs and other materials in one organized digital collection. Its purpose is to preserve useful information and make it accessible for future reference.

history.heading: Our History
history.text: Every archive begins with an idea. This project started with a simple goal: to collect, organize and preserve information in a place where it can remain accessible. Over time, the collection has grown into a structured digital archive.

milestones.title: The Beginning
milestones.description: The initial idea and structure of the archive were established.

milestones.title: Digital Collection
milestones.description: The first materials were organized and published in the archive.

milestones.title: Further Development
milestones.description: New categories, documentation and archive features were introduced.

owner.heading: About the Owner
owner.name: Example Archive Owner
owner.biography: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. The archive owner is responsible for the direction, organization and development of this project. This section can contain a personal biography, professional background, interests and other relevant information.

organization.heading: Organization
organization.name: Example Independent Project
organization.description: This archive is currently presented as an independent project. It may be operated by an individual, a group, a company, an institution or a non-profit organization.

collection.heading: About the Collection
collection.description: The archive contains a growing collection of digital materials. Each item can be documented, categorized and connected with other related materials.
collection.approach: Materials are organized to support discovery, reference and long-term preservation. Descriptions and related information may be added to individual archive entries.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: Our mission is to preserve information, support access to knowledge and create an organized resource that can be useful to researchers, readers and future generations.

sections.heading: Purpose and Objectives
sections.text: The archive aims to collect and organize useful information, preserve digital materials and provide a convenient way to explore different subjects. Its structure can develop as the collection grows.

sections.heading: Sources and Documentation
sections.text: Information may come from publications, historical documents, research, public resources and other materials. Individual archive entries may include descriptions, dates, references and source information.

sections.heading: Acknowledgements
sections.text: We would like to thank everyone who contributes knowledge, materials, research and support to the development of this project.
